semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Swagelok Korea provides fluid system solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes, though they do not supply semiconductor-specific materials or equipment.
summary: Swagelok Korea specializes in fluid system solutions, offering comprehensive technical support including product consulting, design, assembly services, and training tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their expertise in fluid systems enhances process reliability and operational efficiency across various stages of semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Engineering services for risk and efficiency analysis

regional_presence.Korea: Swagelok Korea has been operating since 1984, with headquarters in Gwangmyeong and a branch in Busan, focusing on a wide range of customers from semiconductor to hydrogen refueling stations.
